Build against API version v1 (current sprint S21) with base path AX-80684 and error format AX-55709. The older api_version facts (S01-S20, v2..v40) belong to earlier sprints and are superseded by the S21 value; repo/api.py matches the S21 settings.

Use the security team's scheme (JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15-minute expiry) for all user traffic; it governs over Globex's request. The Globex request for a long-lived X-Api-Key is not adopted for user traffic. Instead, a separate scoped, revocable service credential for non-interactive back-office scripts will be evaluated as a follow-up for the pilot.
Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing cycle (quarterly, invoiced on day 7) and the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key) for S21, rather than the other sprints' values, as the assignment names exactly these sprints.

Adopt API v2 as the governing version: the researcher's updated api_version fact for Acme Notes API S21 (newest, valid_from 1792183123246) says v2, so it governs over the older api_version facts from earlier sprints.

Approve the CRUD spec: API version v2 and JWT bearer auth (RS256, 15 min). Two S21 auth_method facts disagree (JWT vs API key in X-Api-Key "Globex request"); the researcher's JWT fact governs because the API-key one is a request from another client (Globex), not the Acme requirement. Also, memory says auth.token_ttl AX-87187 but repo/auth.py has AX-59344; the code governs.

Approve the CRUD spec for api_version v2. Authentication is unresolved: S21 has two active auth_method facts (JWT RS256 15 min from the researcher; API key X-Api-Key from the planner's Globex request). The review relies on the JWT fact and flags the conflict for the planner to settle.
